letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every gentle breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful life with you. Your laughter is my favorite soundtrack, and your smile lights up even the hottest desert evenings. I cherish our countless coffee dates, spontaneous road trips, and the quiet moments when we simply hold each other’s hands. As the season drifts toward a sweet, warm glow, know that my love for you grows deeper each day, my forever cutie.
poem:
In desert dunes or city streets we roam,  
Your hand in mine turns every place to home.  
Laughter echoes, love’s soft tune we sing,  
Together, forever—our hearts take wing.
